ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-contrast overall with over 90% of the fluke area occupied by low-intensity pixels (values 0-50). High-intensity pixels (values 200-255) are limited to less than 5% of the total fluke surface area, concentrated at the distal tips and linear markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly uniform dark-gray to black macro-intensity. High-contrast white contiguous blobs are mapped to the extreme distal edges of both the left and right lobes. Faint, lower-contrast gray mottling is detected at the lower proximal region of the left lobe near the waterline.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central bifurcation with an approximate pixel angle of 40 degrees and a vertical depth occupying 15% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular peaks and valleys. Serrations are more pronounced on the left lobe's trailing edge with amplitudes of 10-20 pixels. The right lobe exhibits a smoother but still jagged continuous boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to both the left and right lobe trailing edges, sweeping upward and outward from the notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white pixels with irregular circular morphology localized at the lateral-most tips of both lobes, indicating high-contrast pixel disruption relative to the dark lobe body.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, approximately parallel vertical linear pixel disruptions observed on the mid-ventral surface of the left lobe, showing high-contrast white pixels against the dark background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Vertical linear white scarring (rake marks) on the left lobe; heavy high-intensity pixel encrustation/lesions on the distal tips of both lobes.
